projects.title: Lean AI Ops
projects.description: Turn operational friction into structured improvement work, with a DMAIC workspace, evidence discipline and an analytics workbench.
projects.detail: Python and Streamlit power the working application. The public browser interface is a deterministic demonstration, not the assessment engine.

projects.title: AI Release Validator
projects.description: Validate the structure and logical consistency of evidence-bearing AI release-decision records, including non-compensable gates.
projects.detail: Checks the provided decision record. It does not determine regulatory obligations, certify safety or authenticate underlying evidence.

projects.title: Automotive LLM Eval Harness
projects.description: Explore transparent scoring, reproducibility and illustrative safety/privacy gates for synthetic in-cabin assistant scenarios.
projects.detail: Scores supplied case artifacts; it does not generate model responses or independently measure an LLM.

projects.title: Agent Evaluation Framework
projects.description: Design evaluations that separate measurement validity, coverage, hard gates and release judgment instead of collapsing them into one score.
projects.detail: Includes guidance, a semantic validator, templates and fictional worked examples. It is not a leaderboard.

projects.title: Everything Program Management
projects.description: Reusable program-management artifacts, structured templates, examples and validation utilities.

projects.title: AI Governance Playbook
projects.description: Practical operating-model patterns for oversight, ownership, accountability and enterprise AI delivery.

projects.title: Agent Simulator
projects.description: Demonstrate bounded multi-agent behavior using reviewable scenarios and explicit system constraints.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Governance
projects.description: Control and accountability patterns for coordinating multiple agents and their tools.

projects.title: AI Prism
projects.description: Curated practical references for AI governance, evaluation, risk, release readiness and incident response.

projects.title: Prompt Harness Translator
projects.description: Explore prompt portability across different agent and execution harnesses.

projects.title: MCP & Agent Risk Checklist
projects.description: Review risks and proposed controls before integrating agent tools or MCP servers.

projects.title: NIST AI RMF Guide
projects.description: Practical guidance and cross-references for working with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
